chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"If it pleases you to purify your salat (prayer), then put forward the best among you."

key_terms.خِيَارَكُمْ: the best ones among you in merit and quality
key_terms.صَلَاتَكُمْ: your salat (prayer), especially in the communal sense here

ai.seo_question: Who should be chosen to lead congregational salat (prayer) in Islam?
ai.summary: The Imam عليه السلام instructs the believers to appoint the best among them to lead the congregational salat (prayer). The narration emphasizes that the quality and integrity of the prayer leader are connected to the perfection and purification of the community’s worship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.1101 - Imam (as) said:
"If it pleases you to purify and perfect your prayers, then choose the best among you (to lead)."
